scope: #021/B7 public diagnostic: test the value of measured ancilla leakage flags on the exact same repetitions. Not a replacement for the original T5 challenge.

experiment.selection: First shared power-of-two round count >4 in provider train/test. Retain all eight states and all test shots; choose level 0 and level 3 (no and active injection) before scoring.

decoder.family: Exact sum-product on independent data flips and two accumulating ancilla bits; finally condition on two terminal parities, not the individual data bits or terminal flags.
decoder.ancilla_and_terminal_hard_rule: 1 and 2 map to 1, matching the source preprocessing.
decoder.training: Use only provider train files and 512 evenly-spaced rows per prepared state. Choose (data_flip, measurement_flip) per injection level by joint hard-view likelihood including terminal data; freeze those same parameters across all test policies. Use measurement_flip independently on each terminal data bit.
decoder.mask: Ignore the corresponding ancilla emission when source readout is class 2; otherwise exactly the hard decoder. The shift control retains flags per readout line and misaligns them by one cyclic round.

diagnostic: Report paired recoveries/regressions and exact one-sided binomial p values per arm, with no pooled outcome, no shot postselection, and no transfer to the original three challenge rows.
claim_boundary: Provider class 2 is a measured assignment, not latent ground truth. This repetition-code replay alone does not establish readout-calibration epoch identity, original T5 improvement, B7 credit or production performance.
